model.description: The pre-built model on the instance used by the form. This must be specified when the component is created.

readOnly.description: If true, suppress editing of the content, even if the model allows it.

hideEmptyFields.description:
If true, hide fields whose content is empty. This means that the fields could change when rebuilding the component
with different model instances, but works well with uniform models or when there is only a single model displayed.

columnCount.description:
The desired number of columns of inputs. Note that responsive layout may reduce this to a single column on small
displays.

title:
This component manages a form presentation of a model on an Obj instance.

@see UiModel
name: ModelForm
